rows.en: Oho...? Are you running away in fear of my giant space monster?
So that's the extent of your strength after all! Fuhahahahahahahahaha...!!
Fuhahahahahahahahaha...!!
{8074} and the others decided to return to base and work out a plan.
Like this, we can't get any further. Shouldn't we go back to base and rethink our plan?
...I see. So we can't go any further unless we break through that room.
Still, it's a stroke of luck that we managed to rescue Kamen Rider 2, at least.
But why would Skull... No, why would the Dummy Dopant...
...save Rider 2...?
...I don't know either. Maybe it was scheming something.
For now, let's just focus on Rider 1 and the Ultra Brothers.
But to save Rider 1 and my brothers, we have to defeat Bemstar...
That mouth of its is the problem...
...Sorry to keep you waiting.
Hikari, how'd it go? Did you find anything that could plug that mouth?
Well... no good... There's nothing we can use.
If only we had some highly adhesive substance... Something like birdlime, for example...
Huh? Birdlime?
What is it, Ankh? Does that ring a bell?
Ankh grudgingly began telling them of the birdlime-like stuff he'd seen lying in the enemy lab.
...That's most likely a "Polymer Plaster Bomb." It must have misfired in an experiment.
There may still be some usable ones left. It's worth checking out.
Got it. Let's go back there one more time.
Okay!!
You've gotta be kidding me...
What's wrong, Ankh? Not feeling up to it?
This Cube doesn't smell of Yummies, that's why.
Whatever. I'll tag along with you a little longer.
Obtained the "Polymer Plaster Bomb".
Found it...! With this, we can defeat the Modified Bemstar!
Found it! With this, we oughta be able to beat the Modified Bemstar!
Found it...! With this, we should be able to beat the Modified Bemstar...!
Found it! With this, we should be able to defeat the Modified Bemstar!
Found it! With this, we can beat the Modified Bemstar!
Found it! With this, we can beat the Modified Bemstar!
Alriiight, found it!! Modified Bemstar, you bastard, you just wait!!
The "Polymer Plaster Bomb"... Can we defeat the Modified Bemstar with this?
The "Polymer Plaster Bomb"... Can we defeat the Modified Bemstar with this?
Found it! With this, we can defeat the Modified Bemstar!
Oho...? You came back? How laughable.
Have you come to fight the Modified Bemstar?
Fuhahahahaha!! Then I won't hold back either!
Modified Bemstar!!
Hey! OOO! Throw the Polymer Plaster Bomb at that thing's belly!!
R-right... But I'll have to aim carefully...
Tch, you're hopeless! Gimme that! I'll do the throwing!!
Ankh aimed for the Modified Bemstar's belly mouth and hurled the Polymer Plaster Bomb!!
The bomb hit its mark and sealed the mouth on its belly.
Mebius took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Zero took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
OOO took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
W took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Nu Gundam took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Zeta Gundam took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Den-O took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
00 took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Wing Zero took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
Black RX took aim at the mouth on the Modified Bemstar's belly,
and hurled the Polymer Plaster Bomb!!
The bomb hit its mark and sealed the mouth on its belly.
Kiiih!?
I see, so that's your move...
Now we can win!!
All right! Now we can win!!
Now we can win!!
Now we can win!!
Now we can win!!
Now we can win!!
Alriiight! This'll be a cakewalk!!
Now we can win!
Now we can win!
All right! Now we can win!!
In that case...! I'll make my next move as well!
Bemstar isn't the only one I've modified!!
Sabotendar! Verokron! You're up!!
Heh heh heh heh...
Impressive, heroes. It seems we have no choice but to move on to our next operation...
I've opened the door at the back! Now, go forth!
Fuhahahahahahaha!!

notes.note: Duplicate of the laugh in #0.84; the 0314 script never shows it (Yapool's box is #0.83-84). Translated anyway, attributed to Yapool.
Ankh (script-confirmed): shown when the party re-approaches the Bemstar room without a countermeasure.

#0.89-#0.112 are a base scene with no recovered script (no .bla references these entries). Speakers inferred: #0.89 calm 'da ne' (likely Philip); #0.93 Rider 2 (just rescued, 'I don't know either'); #0.95 Mebius ('my brothers' = Ultra Brothers); #0.96/#0.98 casual (likely Zero); #0.97/#0.99/#0.100/#0.104-#0.106 Hikari (the one sent to search, explains the bomb); #0.101/#0.109/#0.111/#0.112 Ankh. Others left neutral.
Source uses the full name 'Kamen Rider 2' here, so the full form is kept; 'fukouchuu no saiwai' rendered 'a stroke of luck'.
Sentence split across #0.91/#0.92; English cut at the matching point. The speaker corrects 'Skull' to 'the Dummy Dopant' (revealed impostor) and does not say 'oyassan', so probably not Shotaro.
Dropped subject restored as 'it' = the Dummy Dopant (glossary g=n).
Hikari reporting; 'nothing we can use' keeps the impersonal source while restoring a verb.
'Torimochi' = 'birdlime', matching story_044/047 (the sticky stuff Ankh, a bird Greeed, feared in 0308).
Ankh g=m. He tells it 'reluctantly' because the birdlime scared him in 0308.
Item name rendered "Polymer Plaster Bomb" (literal: high-polymer plaster bomb); not in glossary. 'Bouhatsu' = accidental detonation.
Speaker unknown; cheerful 'Okay!!' kept as is.
Source has a typo kanji (a look-alike of the character for 'smell'); read as 'no Yummy smell'. Ankh only cares about Cubes that yield Yummies/Cell Medals; 'that's why' carries the kara-na reason.
#0.2-#0.11 are leader variants with labels confirmed by the extractor: Mebius, Zero, OOO, W (Philip), Nu, Zeta, Den-O Sword (Momotaros voice), 00, Wing Zero, Black RX.
Unlabelled; continues Yapool's line from #0.1. #0.4 also Yapool.
'Yatsu' = Modified Bemstar (g=n), rendered 'that thing'.
#0.12-#0.21 are party-leader narration variants, completed by #0.22 ('and hurled...'); comma kept so the two boxes read as one sentence, matching the source split.
Short shriek; distinct from the full 'Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!' roar used in story_047.
#0.26-#0.35 are leader variants in the same order as 0315 (#0.26 labelled Black RX by the extractor but sits in Mebius's slot; #0.28 OOO matches). #0.32 is Momotaros-style ('rakushou' = cakewalk).
Sabotendar and Verokron: Ultraman Ace Choju, standard English names; not in glossary.
'Fuffuffuffu' rendered 'Heh heh heh heh...' to differ from the 'Fufufufufu' laugh (story_047 #0.37).

report: 80/80 rows. 0314 #0.89-#0.112 base scene has no recovered speakers; speakers inferred (Hikari, Ankh, Rider 2, Mebius, likely Zero/Philip). 0316 #0.26 mislabelled Black RX (Mebius slot). Not in glossary: "Polymer Plaster Bomb", Sabotendar, Verokron.
